description: K₂NaAsCl₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. K is bonded to twelve equivalent Cl atoms to form KCl₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent KCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent KCl₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with four equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra, and faces with four equivalent AsCl₆ octahedra. All K-Cl bond lengths are 3.71 Å. Na is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent AsCl₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent KCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.74 Å. As is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form AsCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra and faces with eight equivalent KCl₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All As-Cl bond lengths are 2.50 Å. Cl is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to four equivalent K, one Na, and one As atom.
